statement: A voluntary winding up is a members' voluntary winding up only where the directors have made a statutory declaration of solvency under s 89: a declaration, made within the 5 weeks immediately preceding the winding-up resolution (or on that date before it passes) and embodying a statement of assets and liabilities, that the company will pay its debts in full with interest at the official rate within a stated period not exceeding 12 months; where no such declaration is made, the winding up is a creditors' voluntary winding up (Insolvency Act 1986 ss 89, 90).
caveat: In a creditors' voluntary winding up the liquidator is the person nominated by the creditors or, absent a creditor nomination, the company's nominee (s 100), so creditors control the appointment. The liquidation is administered by a liquidator qualified to act as an insolvency practitioner, under the Act and the Insolvency (England and Wales) Rules 2016. This repo does not choose an insolvency route.
